name: Suddenly Sensei
source:
Play as yourself or roleplay while building a student-tutor relationship with Nino, a beautiful young student who only has a month to improve her grades before she flunks out!

[From [url=https://neatcowgames.itch.io/suddenly-sensei]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演你自己或角色扮演，同时与尼诺建立师生关系，尼诺是一位美丽的年轻学生，只有一个月的时间来提高成绩，然后就会被退学！

[来自[url=https://neatcowgames.itch.io/suddenly-sensei]Itch.io[/url]]
